title: BSi - British Standards Institute
description: British Standards Institute - the National Standards Body of the UK, responsible for facilitating, drafting, publishing and marketing British Standards and other guidelines. Access UK standardization through European (CEN, CENELEC, ETSI) and international bodies (ISO, IEC).

## Standards Development Categories

BSi standards are organized into the following programmes:

- **Building and Civil Engineering**
- **Materials and Chemicals**
- **Engineering**
- **Electro technical**
- **Consumer Products and Services**
- **Healthcare**
- **Management Systems**
- **DISC (Information Technology)**

## Standards Numbering

British Standards are titled: **BS XXX:Year Title**

Where XXX is the number of the standard.

Representations are sought from consumer organizations, professional institutions, certification bodies, educational establishments, research organizations, UK notified bodies, enforcement bodies, and government departments.

Over 15,000 British Standard publications have been published covering all major industries and sectors.
